description: Checks the domain's authoritative nameservers again now for a connection still in progress and returns its status. At most once every 5 minutes per connection (429 before that); a connection already completed or failed answers 409 and nothing is checked.

sandboxToken.description: The auth_token of a sandbox session. Used only when the request carries no credentials; the request then runs against the simulated sandbox provider (no real DNS).

name: recheck_propagation
title: Check propagation now
